title: Local scalar perfect models for dualizable condensed sheaves
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], let $R=\Gamma(*,\Lambda)$, and let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Write $\Lambda_X=p_X^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and work in the ordinary unbounded derived category $D(X_{\mathrm{proet}},\Lambda_X)$ of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with derived tensor and unit $\Lambda_X[0]$. Dualizable means admitting a dual with evaluation and coevaluation satisfying both triangle identities. The full subcategory of dualizable objects is stable: it contains zero and is closed under isomorphisms, integer shifts and distinguished cones.

Assume now that $X$ has Zariski locally finitely many irreducible components. An object $K$ of this derived category is dualizable if and only if there is a pro-etale covering $\{U_i\to X\}$ and, for each $i$, a perfect scalar complex $P_i\in D(R)$ [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex] such that
$$K|_{U_i}\simeq\Lambda_{U_i}\otimes^L_{\underline R}\underline{P_i}.$$
Here a perfect scalar complex is isomorphic to a bounded complex of finitely generated projective $R$-modules, underlines denote constant sheaves with discrete coefficients, and scalar extension uses the constant-section map $\underline R\to\Lambda_{U_i}$. The complexes $P_i$ may vary with $i$. No regularity or flatness assumption on $\Lambda$ is imposed.
